result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there are a few visual issues: duplicated restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, horizontally clipped card content on the right edge, and a partially cut-off category chip.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards side by side with the same image, delivery time (15–25 min), and price (€0.90 delivery). This looks like duplicated/placeholder data rather than distinct restaurants.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel pulls distinct restaurants. If duplication is intentional (e.g., two branches), differentiate them with location or branch labels so they don't appear as a rendering bug.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' ('Smash Bros Bu...') is clipped at the right screen edge, truncating the restaurant name. While horizontal scroll affordance is implied, the truncation can look broken at a glance.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade or peek spacing to signal scrollability, and ensure card titles use ellipsis truncation gracefully rather than hard clipping mid-word.

issues.description: The category filter row ends with a partially visible chip cut off at the right edge after 'Healthy', which may look like a layout glitch rather than an intentional scroll hint.
issues.suggestion: Provide a clear scroll affordance (edge gradient or partial chip peek with consistent spacing) so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The notification bell icon relies on a small red dot to indicate unread alerts, which is a color-only cue and may be missed by color-blind users or at a glance.
issues.suggestion: Add a numeric badge or non-color indicator (e.g., a count) to convey unread notifications accessibly.
